# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser canvas endless runner titled **Neo Capsule Run: W Rizz Relay**. Preserve a one-thumb jump runner loop: fixed-position runner, tap/Space jump only when grounded, gravity landing, right-to-left hazards, optional airborne collectibles, distance score, +100 collectible bonus, collision game over, and restart.

Present the game as a satirical Akira-adjacent cyber-y2k shonen meme chase without using protected source assets: a neon capsule-bike avatar rides through a procedural Neo Tokyo friends-session lane, jumps drone barricades and clout pylons, collects glowing W-rizz capsules, builds a clout meter, and crashes into a ratio-fail state. Use Orbitron for title/HUD, Rajdhani for readable mobile copy, neon cyan/magenta/gold palette, compact glass HUD cards, and browser-native Canvas/CSS effects.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a canvas endless runner: one-thumb tap/click or Space/ArrowUp triggers a jump only while grounded; gravity pulls the round runner back to a fixed ground line; hazards scroll from right to left; collectibles may spawn above hazards; score increases over distance and by +100 for collectibles; collision with a hazard enters game over; restart resets the run.

## Protected mechanics
- Input: canvas tap/pointerdown and Space/ArrowUp jump; UI buttons remain native click/tap.
- Movement: fixed horizontal player position, vertical velocity jump, gravity, ground landing.
- Loop: requestAnimationFrame update/draw loop with delta clamp.
- Spawns: random obstacle type and optional airborne collectible.
- Collision: player circle approximation against obstacle rectangles; collectible circle distance.
- Scoring/failure: distance score ticks, +100 pickup reward, obstacle collision game over, restart resets state.

## Remixed target
Neo Capsule Run: W Rizz Relay reframes the same runner as a satirical cyber-y2k, shonen/cyberpunk capsule-bike chase through a meme-fueled Neo Tokyo friends lobby. The player is a rolling psychic capsule-bike, hazards are drone barricades and clout pylons, collectibles are W-rizz capsules, score is clout meter, and failure is a ratio crash.
